flashmoe.pull_request_note: The optimized original is upstream FlashMoE with PR #32 (open; head 96ad271) applied: deterministic capacity in input-token order ([E,S] staging, then a stream-ordered GPU prefix/compaction pass), replacing the arrival-order guardedAtomicAdd reservation.
flashmoe.gate_weights_layout: The FlashMoE gate consumes router weights as [E,H] (the RESOLVE case passes router_weights.t().contiguous()); the reference and both reduced programs take logical [H,E] = [512,8]. The reduced optimized program folds the transpose into its indexing.
flashmoe.profile: smoke: S=256, H=512, E=8, capacity 32, top_k 1; GateReductionLevel::singleBlock
flashmoe.scope: Source of the original optimized program. The proved subjects are the reduced router programs in kernels/flashmoe-program-*.cu; their link to this source is RESOLVE's finite same-role bitwise translation check on 8 samples, not a universal equivalence theorem.
